name: fix-pipeline
description: Read a failed GitHub Actions run (run URL, job URL, or owner/repo for the latest failure), find the root cause in its logs, and open a fix PR. Snyk gate failures are fixed deterministically from Snyk's own recommendation (base image, dependency upgrade); build/test failures from the error; credential and infrastructure failures get guidance, no PR. Plans first and changes nothing until you approve. Supports --dry-run.
